This Appeal, Coming On For Final Hearing, This
Day, Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice N.S.Sanjay Gowda
 Oral Judgment

(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE N.S.SANJAY GOWDA) The Insurer is in appeal challenging the award of the Tribunal by which liability has fastened on it for payment of `11,16,896/- for the death of Kamlabai, who was an occupant in the three wheeler auto, which hit a stone, turned turtle and as a result killed Kamlabai.

2. The Tribunal has come to the conclusion that the driver of the auto rickshaw did not possess the requisite driving licence and it has also come to the NC: 2024:KHC-K:6905 conclusion that the vehicle was insured and therefore the Insurer was to pay the compensation and thereafter recover the same from the owner.
3.
Learned counsel for the Insurer has filed an application today and along with the application, he has produced the copy of the policy which was issued in respect of the three wheeler auto.
The Insurance policy issued would indicate that it is only a statutory policy that covers the liability under Section 147 of the Motor Vehicles Act only.

In view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in several cases that the Insurer will not be liable for an occupant of a car, if it had issued a only The Divisional Manager, United India ... vs Mohan And Ors on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2606392/
2 liability policy, the award of the Tribunal fastening liability on the Insurer cannot be accepted.

sentences.text: 4. However, it is also noticed from the policy that the Insurer had collected premium towards a personal accident for unnamed persons in the three wheeler auto and it had limited its liability to the extent of `2,00,000/- and for a maximum of three passengers.

In this view of NC:
2024:KHC-K:6905 the matter, the liability of the Insurer, insofar as instant case, would have to be restricted to `2,00,000/- only along with the corresponding interest payable.
5. In respect to the remaining amount, the claimants would be at liberty to proceed against the owner of the offending vehicle.
To this extent, the award is modified and the appeal is however allowed in part.
6. The amount in deposit, if any, shall be transferred to the Tribunal for disbursal in terms of the award.

Sd/-
